Kolkata teacher suspended over alleged removal of student's tilak

A teacher at a missionary school in Central Kolkata has been suspended following allegations that she repeatedly removed a student's tilak. The Chief Minister stated that an FIR has been ordered against the teacher. The school is a missionary institution. The incident has led to public discussion regarding religious symbols in educational settings.
